authority: This review verifies a deterministic, side-effect-free adapter around the hash-pinned FFDec drawing export.

It does not establish original-host defaults, authoritative local-frame captures, audio identity or synchronization, Spanish behavior, pixel fidelity, product QA, human visual review, or owner acceptance.
The migration manifest remains preserved and no acceptance field is changed.

standaloneAdobeBaseline.limitation: The ten root-frame captures do not freeze the independently playing 142-frame child sprite at a declared local frame.

sourceRoot.frame6: Label begin places sprite object 21 as animation at 8248,5666 twips (412.4,283.3 pixels) and stops.
sourceRoot.normalHostInterpretation: After the preloader advances the child to begin, the root remains at frame 6 while sprite 21 runs its own timeline. Root frames 7..10 therefore are not treated as a clock for sprite-21 frames.

contentTimeline.mapping: public local frame n maps to FFDec switch frame n-1 with the source root pinned at frame 6
contentTimeline.terminal: AVM1 stop() executes on local frame 142; the adapter rejects frames outside 1..142 instead of wrapping.

stagePlacement.derivation: (412.4-536.9, 283.3-198.7); this places the 835x355 sprite-bounds export in the native 800x600 SWF stage rather than treating 835x355 as the movie stage.

soundSprites: Sprite 7 and sprite 8 each stop at frames 1 and 135.
Each contains 135 MP3 SoundStreamBlock frames at 22050 Hz stereo with an audited decoded duration of 11233 ms.
The drawing export advances both nested sprite frame arguments geometrically and contains no audio bytes in its runtime contract; it cannot reproduce the source control actions by itself.

adapterDisposition.seedRule: The unsigned seed modulo two chooses an explicit engineering branch. This is deterministic test control, not a claim that Adobe AVM1 uses that seeded sequence.
adapterDisposition.visualResult: The branch is reported in frame state, but no audio is played and the exported visual drawing is branch-independent.
adapterDisposition.language: Only source-visible English is admitted. lang=es throws until authoritative Spanish visual/audio behavior exists.

removedOrBlocked: 83 ms autoplay interval and implicit looping
network, navigation, worker, persistent-storage and dynamic-import primitives

chromiumEngineeringSmoke.claim: renderability and deterministic-state smoke only; no Adobe-frame pairing or RMSE was performed

productIntegration.reason: The safe fixture remains a synthetic-host candidate. Its sandbox smoke and visible begin-handoff probe pass, and all statically reported parent bindings are dispositioned; however, native AVM1 random(2) has no seed entry, both audio streams remain unaudited by listening/synchronization, Spanish is unavailable, and no authoritative local-frame capture exists.

remainingBlockers: Capture and classify both untouched Adobe random outcomes; do not treat modulo seed mapping as original PRNG evidence.
Identify and listen to both embedded MP3 streams, determine language/content, and capture start/stop synchronization.

Capture an independent fixture event trace and all 142 sprite-21 local frames for each reachable authoritative scenario at 800x600; the current two JPEGs have no exact frame identity and are not RMSE baselines.
Resolve Spanish visual/audio behavior or record an owner-approved exception; the current adapter deliberately rejects es.
Pair every implementation frame to authoritative baselines, compute RMSE/diffs, and complete product, accessibility, human, and owner review.
